meta.title: Optimize collapsible performance
meta.body_summary: Remove forceMount prop from CollapsibleContent in a code block component so heavy CodeMirror instances unmount when collapsed, aiming to improve DOM performance.

perf_labels.notes: Trivial frontend prop removal with no performance evidence; author self-closed PR after agent's own test/lint failures were reported in body.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At just 3 changed lines, this is a microscopic edit. As a speed-oriented performance PR it was closed within a minute by the author, consistent with a self-rejected experiment that reported test/lint failures in the PR body.

review_details.concern_detail: PR body explicitly states that `bun lint` fails (next: command not found) and `bun test` fails (missing modules). Author closed the PR immediately without requesting review from others.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid mounting heavy CodeMirror instances when code block is collapsed by removing forceMount.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: unnecessary_dom_mount (prior forceMount kept CodeMirror in DOM when collapsed)
review_details.rejection_signals: Immediate closure by author after reporting test/lint failures; no human review or follow-up.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced a single-line frontend change but the PR lifecycle was cut short because the agent itself reported that lint and tests fail. The human author closed the PR immediately, highlighting a process failure where basic CI checks prevent progression.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after metrics, benchmarks, or profiling data; performance claim is purely narrative.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by author after test/lint failures were reported; no fix attempt.

core_change_summary.description: In collapsible-code-block.tsx, removed the `forceMount` prop from the `CollapsibleContent` component so that CodeMirror instances are unmounted when the code block is collapsed, potentially reducing DOM overhead.
change_trajectory: Single commit (135cce3) removes forceMount prop and adjusts surrounding logic (2 additions, 1 deletion).

review_signals.summary: Ellipsis bot approved the change with a draft comment noting potential re-mount delays but did not post it.
Vercel bot posted deployment preview status (unrelated to perf validation).
Supabase bot indicated the PR was ignored because no changes were detected in the backend directory.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by Kitenite (Codex agent) with one commit removing forceMount.
Within seconds, bots (Vercel, Supabase, Ellipsis) posted comments and reviews.
PR body reports that lint and tests fail; author closed the PR less than one minute after creation.
